FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A02
Unless an emergency or police direction requires otherwise, do not double park beside a stopped or parked roadside vehicle. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A02
Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park on a sidewalk, crosswalk or within an intersection. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A02
Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park along or opposite road excavation or work areas. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A02
Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park on a bridge, elevated structure or in a highway tunnel. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A02
Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park on railroad tracks or within 50 feet of the nearest rail at a crossing. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A02
Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park between divided-highway roadways, including crossovers. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A02
Except for emergencies or police direction, obey official signs prohibiting stopping or parking. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R08 | anchor: A02
Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park in front of a public or private driveway. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R09 | anchor: A02
Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park within 15 feet of a fire hydrant. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R10 | anchor: A02
Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park within 20 feet of an intersection crosswalk. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R11 | anchor: A02
Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park within 30 feet of a roadside flashing signal, stop sign, yield sign or traffic-control device. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R12 | anchor: A02
Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park within 20 feet of a fire-station driveway entrance. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R13 | anchor: A02
Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park where a streetcar's movement would be blocked. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R14 | anchor: A02
On a limited-access highway, stopping, standing and parking are prohibited unless an emergency, police direction or official traffic-control device allows them. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R15 | anchor: A02
To parallel park at a right curb, begin beside the vehicle ahead, level with it and two feet away. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R16 | anchor: A02
Begin backing slowly toward the rear vehicle with the wheels turned sharply right. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R17 | anchor: A02
As the front door passes the leading vehicle's rear bumper, straighten the wheels and continue backing straight. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R18 | anchor: A02
Once clear of the front vehicle, steer sharply left and continue backing slowly toward the rear vehicle. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R19 | anchor: A02
Finish the parallel park by steering sharply right and pulling forward toward the space's center. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec11-R20 | anchor: A02
Before leaving the vehicle, turn the engine off, remove the key and lock the doors, checking rear traffic before stepping out. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0057]
